title: Karbala Karbala Tere Do Badshah
body:
Karbala Karbala Tere Do Badshah
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Muhammad Ka Beta Ek Zehra Ki Dua
Karbala Karbala Tere Do Badshah
Ek Jawanan e Jannat Ka Sardar Hai
Dusra Bad e Khyber Alamdar Hai
Ek Khuda e Sabr o Raza Ek Quran e Wafa
Ek Woh Jis Ki Marzi Hai Rab Ki Riza
Ek Woh Jis Ko Babul Hawaij Kaha
Dono Haram Ke Beech Main Baitho Mil Jaye Khuda
Ek Sabeelo'n Ka Malik Hai Shah e Umam
Dusre Ki Nishani Hai Mashk o Alam
Aj Talak Daiti Hai Sadayain Nehr e Alqama
Ek Ata Hi Ata Aur Shifa Hi Shifa
Ek Sakha Hi Sakha Aur Wafa Hi Wafa
Ek Ka Darya Par Qabza Ek Dilo'n Ka Sehanshah
Karbala Teri Pehchan Khak e Shifa
Anbiya Ne Yahan Ake Sajda Kiya
Zehra Ke Baito'n Ne Tujhko Rutba Yeh Diya
Mujh Gunahgaar Ki Muaf Kardi Khata
Main Jahanum Se Seedha Jina Main Gaya
Char Qadm Se Hur Ka Roza Daita Hai Sada
Farsh Se Arsh Tak Unka Hi Raaj Hai
Unke Hi Sar Pe Tauheed Ka Taaj Hai
Zinda Unhi Shahzado'n Se Hai Abtak Lailaha
Yeh Teri Manzilat Do Jahan Se Siwa
Zairoo'n Ko Tere Sab Ne Haji Kaha
Mazhar o Mesum Saaray Jahan Main Dete Hai Sada
